crossRefs.note: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever…
He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the…
looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross…

translations.web: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’
translations.bsb: You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’
translations.kjv: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
translations.asv: Thou madest known unto me the ways of life; Thou shalt make me full of gladness with thy countenance.
